fields.label: URL
fields.help: Internal Docker hostname or IP:port for API calls

fields.label: API Key
fields.help: In Sonarr, open Settings, then General

fields.label: Public URL
fields.help: Browser-accessible URL for web UI links. If empty, URL is used.

fields.label: URL
fields.help: Internal Docker hostname or IP:port for API calls

fields.label: API Key
fields.help: In Radarr, open Settings, then General

fields.label: Public URL
fields.help: Browser-accessible URL for web UI links. If empty, URL is used.

title: Media Roots
help: Directories containing media files. Must match paths inside Sonarr/Radarr containers.

fields.label: Path
fields.help: Absolute path to a media root directory

title: Trusted Proxies
help: CIDR ranges of reverse proxies in front of subflux. When set, the real client IP is resolved from a trusted X-Forwarded-For for the audit log, login rate limiter, session records, and access log. Leave empty when subflux is directly exposed.

fields.label: Proxy CIDR
fields.help: Proxy IP range in CIDR notation. A single proxy is a /32, for example 192.168.1.5/32.

title: Allowed Hosts
help: Exact hostnames or IPs subflux answers for. When set, a request whose Host header is not listed is rejected with 403, blocking DNS-rebinding attacks against the browser session. Requests from localhost, such as the container healthcheck, always pass. Leave empty to accept any Host.

fields.label: Hostname or IP
fields.help: Bare hostname or IP without a scheme, path or port, for example subflux.example.com or 192.168.1.5

fields.label: Poll interval
fields.help: How often to check Sonarr/Radarr for new imports (minimum 10s)

title: Languages
help: Audio-to-subtitle language mapping using ISO 639-1 codes.

title: Embedded Subtitles
help: Embedded tracks are always detected for coverage. These toggles only decide which codecs count as usable subtitles.

fields.label: Ignore PGS
fields.help: Treat Blu-ray PGS bitmap subtitles as not usable. They stay in coverage, but external subtitles are searched.

fields.label: Ignore VobSub
fields.help: Treat DVD VobSub bitmap subtitles as not usable. They stay in coverage, but external subtitles are searched.

fields.label: Ignore ASS
fields.help: Treat ASS/SSA styled subtitles, common in anime, as not usable. They stay in coverage, but external subtitles are searched.

settings.label: AniDB Client Key
settings.help: Optional. Enables AniDB episode ID search

settings.label: Use Hash
settings.help: Match by file hash, which is fast and exact

settings.label: Include AI Translated
settings.help: Include subs from OpenSubtitles' own AI translation pipeline

settings.label: Include Machine Translated
settings.help: Include older machine-translated uploads from the Google Translate era

fields.label: Scan Interval
fields.help: Time between full library scans (minimum 1h)

fields.label: Scan Delay
fields.help: Delay after each item that queried providers during a scan, so providers are not overloaded (minimum 5s). Items that need no provider work skip the delay.

fields.label: Provider Timeout
fields.help: Cooldown after a provider fails repeatedly (minimum 1h). Set 0 to disable.

fields.label: Min Score
fields.help: Global minimum score threshold. 0 accepts any match.

fields.label: Exclude Arr Tags
fields.help: Comma-separated Sonarr/Radarr tag names. Tagged media is skipped during auto scans.

fields.label: Upgrades
fields.help: Search for better-scoring subtitles during scans

fields.label: Upgrade window
fields.help: Only upgrade subtitles downloaded within this many days

fields.label: Initial Delay
fields.help: Wait time before retrying a provider after no results

fields.label: Max Delay
fields.help: Maximum wait between retries

fields.label: Multiplier
fields.help: Multiply delay after each failed search

fields.label: Max Attempts
fields.help: Stop retrying after this many attempts. 0 retries forever.

fields.label: Sync Subtitles
fields.help: Sync downloaded subtitles against embedded reference subtitles to correct timing differences on import

fields.label: Audio Sync Fallback
fields.help: Fall back to audio-based sync when no embedded reference subtitle is available or reference sync fails. Requires Sync Subtitles to be enabled

fields.label: Strip HI
fields.help: Remove hearing-impaired annotations: [sounds], (music), speaker labels

fields.label: Strip Tags
fields.help: Remove HTML formatting tags: <i>, <b>, <u>, <font>

fields.label: Normalize UTF-8
fields.help: Convert subtitle encoding to UTF-8, including from UTF-16 and Windows-1252

fields.label: Normalize Endings
fields.help: Convert line endings to CRLF, the SRT standard

fields.label: Clean Whitespace
fields.help: Trim lines and remove empty lines

fields.label: Remove Empty
fields.help: Drop cues with no text after processing

fields.label: WebAuthn RP ID
fields.help: The registrable domain your passkeys are scoped to. Filled in automatically from the address you first save from. Changing it strands existing passkeys. Clearing it keeps the stored value.

title: Scoring
help: Weights control how subtitles are ranked. Hash match scores 100 automatically.

fields.label: Hash
fields.help: File hash match. It is authoritative and bypasses the other weights.

fields.label: Source
fields.help: Release source, for example BluRay, WEB-DL, HDTV or DVDRip

fields.label: Release Group
fields.help: Scene group name, for example SPARKS or FGT

fields.label: Streaming Service
fields.help: Streaming service, for example AMZN, NF, DSNP or ATVP

fields.label: Video Codec
fields.help: Video codec, for example x264, x265 or AV1

fields.label: HDR
fields.help: HDR format, for example HDR10, Dolby Vision or HDR10+

fields.label: Edition
fields.help: Movie edition, for example Director's Cut, Extended or Theatrical. Movies only.

fields.label: Season Pack
fields.help: Bonus for season packs, which keep subtitles consistent across episodes

fields.label: Frequency
fields.help: How often to write a consistent database snapshot (minimum 1h).

fields.label: Retention
fields.help: How many backup files to keep. Older ones are pruned.

fields.label: Backup Directory
fields.help: Absolute directory for backups. Leave empty to write next to the database.

fields.label: Level
fields.help: Log verbosity. Use debug for troubleshooting.

fields.label: Format
fields.help: JSON for log aggregation such as Loki or Alloy, text for terminal debugging
